mapper.select: select id, title, sub_title as subTitle, kind, is_enabled as isEnabled, points, price, image, stock, available_stock as availableStock, frozen_stock as frozenStock, sale_volume as saleVolume, version, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, remark from points_gift where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into points_gift (title, sub_title, kind, is_enabled, points, price, image, stock, available_stock, frozen_stock, sale_volume, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{title}, #{subTitle}, #{kind}, #{isEnabled}, ifnull(#{points}, 0), ifnull(#{price}, 0), #{image}, ifnull(#{stock}, 0), ifnull(#{stock}, 0), 0, ifnull(#{saleVolume}, 0), 0, #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from points_gift where id in #{id}
mapper.update: update points_gift set stock = stock + #{stockDelta}, available_stock = available_stock + #{stockDelta}, sale_volume = sale_volume + #{salesDelta}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and stock + #{stockDelta} >= 0 and available_stock + #{stockDelta} >= 0 and sale_volume + #{salesDelta} >= 0
